python -c "
import time, os, subprocess, glob
log_file = 'F:/CellBender_v2/monitor.log'
cb_dir = 'F:/CellBender_v2/cellbender_output'
pipeline_log = 'F:/CellBender_v2/logs/pipeline.log'
while True:
    # count filtered.h5
    filtered = glob.glob(f'{cb_dir}/**/*filtered.h5', recursive=True)
    n_done = len(filtered)
    # GPU
    try:
        gpu = subprocess.run(['nvidia-smi', '--query-gpu=utilization.gpu,memory.used', '--format=csv,noheader'],
                           capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5).stdout.strip()
    except:
        gpu = '?'
    # last pipeline line
    try:
        with open(pipeline_log, 'r') as f:
            lines = f.readlines()
            last = lines[-1].strip() if lines else ''
    except:
        last = ''
    ts = time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')
    with open(log_file, 'a') as f:
        f.write(f'[{ts}] done={n_done}/26 gpu={gpu} last={last}\n')
    time.sleep(120)
" &
